learning_outcomes.text: Enhanced basic understanding of semiconductor physics.
Understanding important optoelectronic devices such as the semiconductor diode laser and solar cell.
Preparation of the students for attending postgraduate level classes in the field of semiconductors and optoelectronics.
Search for, analysis and synthesis of data and information, with the use of the
Production of free, but structured, creative and inductive thinking

teaching_methods: Use of teleclass for communication and material uploading
Use of Power Point during lectures
assessment_rules: Students have the choice to be evaluated by one of three methods: (1) graded homework, a class presentation, and a final written exam; (2) homework and a final exam; or (3) only a final exam. The exams are in Greek and typically involve solving 3 to 4 problems related to semiconductor physics and devices. Students can view their exam scripts after grading results are published.
